description: 1. Read SKILL.md to understand the docs-registry.json format: each project entry must be a JSON object with at minimum a 'url' field, and optionally 'llms', 'github', 'local' fields. 2. Edit /workspace/docs-registry.json to add a 'meridian' key with at least {'url': 'http://localhost:9876', 'llms': '/llms-full.txt'} — preserving all existing entries. 3. Run `node /workspace/fetch-docs.js meridian --raw --save` from the workspace directory. The --raw flag suppresses the metadata header (# Docs:, # Source:, # Size:, # Fetched: lines), and --save writes the output to `meridian-docs.txt` in the current directory. The tool will fetch http://localhost:9876/llms-full.txt (following the fetch priority: llms-full.txt first), and write only the raw documentation content to meridian-docs.txt. The proprietary traps are: (a) using the exact registry JSON format with the correct field names, (b) knowing to use --raw to suppress the metadata header, and (c) knowing that --save combined with --raw produces a file with no tool-injected headers.
